parsed.lead: The Gold Bee Relic is a relic.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A trophy commemorating the feats and trials of the diminutive Autobot Bumblebee. This is the award granted to those who master the Bumblebee GS Special Mission.

sections.heading: Relic Boosts
sections.text: +10% Gold Generation

sections.heading: Obtainment
sections.text: The description implies that this relic was intended to be the reward for a Bumblebee Special mission or Bee's Gauntlet, but ultimately did not come to pass. Instead the gold relic was given to Commanders who had logged in the game's first anniversary during v8.0 and the second anniversary.

parsed.lead:
Relics are rare collectible items that give a small permanent boost when placed on the Commander's Base. Up to four Relics can be placed in a Base. They can be acquired in Story and Special Missions, or purchased in the Raid Store in exchange of currencies like Chips or Relic Tickets. They can be sold for a mere 500 Gold.

Starting from Tantrum's Spotlight Missions in July 2018, selections of previous Special Mission Relics are available to purchase for two months at at time with Raid Tickets earned by mastering Spotlight Missions. Tier 1 Relics cost two tickets, Tier 2 three tickets, Tier 3 four tickets, Tier 4 five tickets, and a special, rare relic for 20 tickets. Only one of each can ever be bought, so you'll end up with a huge stack of unusable tickets.

sections.text: Note there is no official class categorization for Relics, this is primarily categorized by obtainment method.
